@@U03333@@
Plunge into 珀涅俄斯河! There! Oh, what joy it is to swim, Splashing, singing hymn on hymn, For these poor mortals in despair! Without water naught will thrive! Hurry, then, and when we gain The vast 爱琴海’s azure main Every pleasure shall revive!

@@U03334@@
(Earthquake.)

@@U03335@@
The wildly foaming wave sweeps back, No longer in its ancient track; All earth quakes, the waters shiver, Bank and gravel smoke and quiver. Let us flee this, one and all, Before a worse disaster fall! Away, and let our joys abound In bright ocean’s festive round, Where gentle billows lap the shore, Rippling, sparkling at 涅普顿’s door; where the fair moon floats on high, shedding light in a glistening sky, And, mirrored in the ocean’s blue, Wets us with her sacred dew. Life is freedom in the ocean, Here we suffer dread commotion.

@@U03337@@
(Growling and grumbling deep in the earth.)

@@U03338@@
One more thrust with might and main, Let the shoulders heave and strain, And we earth’s upper crust will gain, Where all life gives way before us!
translation:
@@U03333@@
跳入珀涅俄斯河！那里！哦，游泳是多么快乐啊， 溅起水花，唱着赞美诗， 对于这些绝望中的可怜凡人！没有水，万物都无法茁壮成长！那么，快点吧，当我们获得了广阔的爱琴海的蔚蓝主线时，一切欢乐都会复苏！

@@U03334@@
（地震。）

@@U03335@@
汹涌的泡沫卷回，不再在古老的轨道上；所有的地震，海水都在颤抖，河岸和碎石都冒着烟雾和颤抖。让我们在一场更严重的灾难降临之前，一并逃离这里！走吧，让我们的欢乐在明亮的海洋的节日轮回中，温柔的波浪拍打着海岸，在涅普顿的门口荡漾，闪闪发光；美丽的月亮高高地漂浮着，在闪闪发光的天空中洒下光芒，并反射在蓝色的海洋中，用她神圣的露珠润湿我们。生命是海洋中的自由，在这里我们遭受可怕的骚动。

@@U03337@@
（在地底深处咆哮和抱怨。）

@@U03338@@
再大力一推，让肩膀起伏并拉紧，我们地球的上层地壳将获得收益，所有生命都在我们面前屈服！
